name: Cslib.FreeM.bind_assoc
lines: ⊢ (x.bind f).bind g = x.bind fun x => (f x).bind g
⊢ ((pure a).bind f).bind g = (pure a).bind fun x => (f x).bind g
ih : ∀ (i : ι✝), ((cont i).bind f).bind g = (cont i).bind fun x => (f x).bind g
⊢ (((lift op).bind cont).bind f).bind g = ((lift op).bind cont).bind fun x => (f x).bind g

steps.tactic:
induction x with
| pure a => rfl
| lift_bind op cont ih => simp [← liftBind_eq, FreeM.bind, ih] at *
